title: Mushroom Eye Surreal Dreamscape
description: A giant red Amanita muscaria mushroom with a detailed blood-red eye at its center dominates the right side of the frame. Below it lies a glowing green and purple mountain landscape, while the left side shows a winding road leading toward a futuristic city skyline under a fiery orange sunset with swirling clouds and green aurora borealis.
prompt: Surreal fantasy landscape featuring a massive red Amanita mushroom with a realistic bloodshot eye in its cap floating above glowing mountains. To the left, a winding road leads to a futuristic city skyline beneath a dramatic orange sunset with swirling clouds and vibrant green northern lights. White line-art flowers and smaller mushrooms frame the bottom corners, cinematic lighting, highly detailed digital painting.
